confirmedRules.name: H invokes K then L on success
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: H-module calls FTFCK100 with STG header and function input; on success calls FTFCL100 with same linkage.
confirmedRules.then: L-module is invoked before H completes

confirmedRules.name: Decimal point is comma
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: COBOL uses European decimal comma for numeric literals and edited pictures across H/K/L and helpers.
confirmedRules.given: Any module with Special-Names Decimal-Point Is Comma

confirmedRules.name: K-module initial check calls F115L050
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Before continuing, K initializes R115L050-Initial-Check and CALLs F115L050.
confirmedRules.then: F115L050 is called with R115L050-Initial-Check and R7919999-Error-Area
edgeCases: F115L050.src is in legacy/STG/TFC10 as of 2026-09-29

confirmedRules.name: Return-Error stops K path
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: When R7919999-Return-Error is set after a sub-call, K-module error handling applies.
confirmedRules.given: A nested CALL sets error area
confirmedRules.then: K does not treat the path as success
confirmedRules.smeQuestion: Confirm exact K behavior when only Return-Warning is set versus Return-Error.

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 requires function and medium
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Initial check abends if Function or Medium is spaces.
confirmedRules.then: Message TF-SY-FUNC-AND-MEDIUM is raised, paragraph C102, Z900-Abend

confirmedRules.name: Invalid status and operation-type combination
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: F115L050 rejects invalid STATUS to OPERATION-TYPE relation from F115ISR0.
confirmedRules.when: F115ISR0 returns error for VALID-ST-OP relation
confirmedRules.then: TF-SY-INVALID-STATUS-OPERTYP is logged with operation type and status variables, paragraph F102, Z700-Error-AE
edgeCases: Contract-type split adjusts From/To contract type on R115ISR0

confirmedRules.name: Permanent status blocks in-progress main contract
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Permanent status (PERM in properties) with in-progress main contract is rejected except for function TFD05.
confirmedRules.given: G000-Check-Properties runs after status properties read
confirmedRules.when: R115ISC0-Property contains PERM, R115IMC0-In-Progress-Yes, and R115L050-Function is not TFD05

confirmedRules.name: Contract number via F115L020
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: F115L020 generates contract numbers when invoked from L with R115L020-Gen-Contract-No.
confirmedRules.then: Contract number field populated per R115L020 layout
confirmedRules.smeQuestion: Confirm production contract-number sequence rules beyond in-repo mock paths.

confirmedRules.name: Shadow work-charge cleanup (F115L090)
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: F115L090 deletes in-work part and main charge shadows for a contract key.
confirmedRules.given: F115L090 invoked for a contract key
confirmedRules.when: In-work part- and main-charge shadows exist
confirmedRules.then: Each shadow row is deleted via F115IPC0 and F115ICH0 until no more rows

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 main-contract table version ACTUAL vs WORK
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Initial check reads main contract twice when in-progress, switching table version WORK then ACTUAL.
confirmedRules.then: Ws-Table-Version moves to WORK and C200-Read-Main-Contract runs again; otherwise ACTUAL

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 PA-Seq-No zero skips amount reads
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: When PA sequence number is zero, status comes from main contract only; otherwise contract and part amounts are read.
confirmedRules.then: Ws-Status moves from R115IMC0-Status without C250/C300 amount reads
edgeCases: Non-zero PA-Seq-No triggers F115ICA0 and F115IPA0 calls

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 skips property check for read and SHOW
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: G000-Check-Properties is skipped when function position 3 is R and operation type is SHOW.

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 linkage version conversion
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Input/output areas must match R115L050 version and length or F115L999 converts via INPUT/OUTPUT.
confirmedRules.when: First 8 bytes or length do not match current R115L050 version layout
confirmedRules.then: F115L999 is called for INPUT or OUTPUT conversion; abend paragraphs ZI03 or ZO01 on abend

confirmedRules.name: Date plus days (F7919010)
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: F7919010 returns a date offset from Gregorian yyyyMMdd inputs.
confirmedRules.then: Output date is returned per calendar mode (360-day path when requested in copybook flags)
confirmedRules.smeQuestion: Confirm 360-day calendar branch when F7919060 is not in-tree.

confirmedRules.name: Machine timestamp (F7919070)
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: F7919070 obtains machine timestamp via F7919071 and COBOL date via F7919072.
confirmedRules.then: W-DB2-TMS and W-COB-Date are populated from nested calls

confirmedRules.name: Bank-day lookup (F7919090)
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: F7919090 evaluates bank-day and holiday semantics for a calendar date.
confirmedRules.given: A calendar date in R7919090 layout
confirmedRules.then: Bank-day flag, weekday, and days-to-next-bank-day are returned
confirmedRules.smeQuestion: Confirm holiday table source when DB tables are not in one-hop tree.

confirmedRules.name: Timestamp format conversion (F7919270)
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: F7919270 converts date and time components to DB2-style and compact timestamp fields.
confirmedRules.given: Date and time components in R7919270
confirmedRules.then: Equivalent DB2-style and compact timestamp fields are populated

confirmedRules.name: H-module must not be hand-edited
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Header comment states FTFCH100 must not be modified by human hands.

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 update-timestamp check disabled on main path
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: E000-Check-Upd-Timestamp call is commented out in C000-Interface (July test note); E000 section still implements mismatch error E001.
confirmedRules.when: Production code path as checked in
confirmedRules.then: Perform E000-Check-Upd-Timestamp is not executed from C000 (commented)
edgeCases: If re-enabled, mismatch raises TF-SY-UPD-DATED-BY-VAR1 paragraph E001
confirmedRules.smeQuestion: Was the July disable intentional for all environments or test-only?
confirmedRules.suspectedDefect: Comment suggests temporary disable; parity may depend on which branch is live.

rejectedRules.name: Initial check always validates last-update timestamp
rejectedRules.reason: C000 Perform E000-Check-Upd-Timestamp is commented out at lines 119-123; not active on main path.

fields.name: R115L050-Function
fields.note: STG function code including position 3 R read flag

fields.name: R115L050-Medium
fields.note: Required with Function; spaces trigger C102 abend

fields.name: R115L050-Operation-Type
fields.note: Used with status in F115ISR0 VALID-ST-OP check

fields.name: R7919999-Return-Error
fields.note: Soft error; Z700-Error-AE sets and Goback

fields.name: R7919999-Return-Abend
fields.note: Hard abend; Z900-Abend sets and Goback

fields.name: R7919999-Paragraph
fields.note: Diagnostic paragraph id e.g. C102, F102, G001
